title: 第346章 卡符第347章 密道
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: 哥布林村庄内。
林奇目光灼灼的盯着安琪拉。
对方的气势、源力波动，正在清晰可见的攀升着。
很快，半个时辰过去了。
安琪拉手中的初级火焰卡符，彻底褪去了原本的火焰光泽，变得灰暗无光。
但她整个人的气势已然攀升至八星御卡大师巅峰，周身萦绕的源力甚至比林奇还要更凝练。
“怎么样？怎么样了？”
安琪拉刚一睁开眼，就看到三张凑得极近、写满期待的大脸。
林奇的声音更是带着难掩的急切。
安琪拉嘴角扬起一抹笑容：“感觉体内的源力变得无比凝练，若是能再多来几块火焰卡符，我都有可能直接突破到御卡宗师。”
“这么厉害？”
林奇眼前一亮，“那如果我吸收这个火焰卡符，是不是也能提升实力？”
安琪拉皱着眉想了想。
先是点了点头，随即又摇了摇头。
“什么意思啊？”
众人面面相觑，被她些举动搞蒙了。
安琪拉见状，连忙解释道：“火焰卡符的特性很特殊，它对于本命卡是火属性的御卡师来说，能起到事半功倍的效果，提升起来又快又安全。
但如果是其他属性本命卡的御卡师，贸然吸收火属性卡符的能量，很可能会导致体内源力紊乱，甚至损伤经脉和身体。”
“那怎么办？”
林奇懵了。
要是照安琪拉这么说，那他岂不是只能寻找亡灵类的秘境卡才能提升实力？
可秘境卡本就罕见，就算是贵族，也很少有人能掌握。
他低声嘀咕着：“怪不得院长当时不肯告诉我秘境卡的事情，原来这里面还有这么多门道……”
安琪拉看着他失落的模样，开口安慰道：
“团长大人别急，使用秘境卡里的东西突破，本就是机缘巧合的事情，不能强求。
不过，您不是有抗火特性吗？
或许可以尝试吸收，只是过程要小心，但杰克绝对不能尝试，他的本命卡属性与火元素相悖，吸收只会有害无益。”
闻言，林奇沉下去的心瞬间又跳动起来，眼中重新燃起光芒。
“对啊！本团长可是有着抗火特性的，只要我吸收火焰卡符的时候你们在一旁盯着，一看情况不对，就给我用一张治愈卡，我就不信我吸收不了。”
听到林奇的想法，安琪拉心头一震。
“这个办法，或许真的可行。抗火特性能帮你抵御火元素的侵蚀，再加上治愈卡兜底，风险会小很多。”
想到林奇向来贪财、喜欢卡恩，安琪拉又补充道：“就算您自己不使用，把火焰卡符拿出去售卖，也能卖个不错的价钱。”
林奇一脸不以为然：“这东西我在拍卖行从来没见过，而且刚才听你说，它提升的力量有限，估计也卖不出什么好价格。”
安琪拉挑了挑眉，显然没想到竟然还有林奇不识货的时候。
“在我们公国内，火焰卡符的确很少见，所以价格不高。但在王国的大型拍卖会上，一枚火焰卡符的价格，堪比一张史诗级卡牌，绝对是供不应求。”
梅比斯惊呼出声，眼睛瞪得溜圆。
她连忙转身跑到自己那堆矿石旁，蹲在地上翻来翻去，生怕自己遗漏了什么。
“我看看有没有漏下的卡符，说不定还有呢。”
“这么贵吗？”
林奇更是不敢相信。
他万万没想到，这看似不起眼的卡符竟然这么值钱！
content_en:
Inside the Goblin Village.
Lin Qi stared at Angela with burning eyes.
The opponent's momentum and source of power fluctuations are clearly rising.
Soon, half an hour passed.
The primary flame card talisman in Angela's hand completely lost its original flame luster and became dull.
But her overall momentum has climbed to the peak of the Eight-Star Royal Card Master, and the source of energy lingering around her is even more condensed than Lynch.
"How's it going? How's it going?"
As soon as Angela opened her eyes, she saw three big faces that were very close to each other and full of expectation.
Lin Qi's voice was even more urgent.
Angela raised a smile at the corner of her mouth: "I feel that the source power in my body has become extremely condensed. If I can get a few more flame card talismans, I may directly break through to the master of card control."
"So powerful?"
Lin Qi's eyes lit up, "Then if I absorb this flame card talisman, can my strength also be improved?"
Angela frowned and thought for a moment.
He nodded first, then shook his head.
"What do you mean?"
Everyone looked at each other, confused by her actions.
Seeing this, Angela quickly explained: "The characteristics of the flame card talisman are very special. For card masters whose natal cards are fire attributes, it can have the effect of getting twice the result with half the effort, and it can be improved quickly and safely.
However, if a card master with other attributes of the natal card rashly absorbs the energy of the fire attribute card, it is likely to cause chaos in the source of energy in the body, and even damage the meridians and body. "
"What should we do?"
Lin Qi was stunned.
If Angela said so, wouldn't it mean that he could only look for undead secret cards to improve his strength?
But secret realm cards are rare, and even nobles, few can master them.
He muttered in a low voice: "No wonder the dean refused to tell me about the secret card. It turns out there are so many ways in it..."
Angela looked at his disappointed look and comforted him:
"Don't worry, Captain, using the things in the secret realm card to break through is a matter of chance and cannot be forced.
But don’t you have fire resistance?
Maybe you can try to absorb it, but you have to be careful in the process, but Jack must not try it. His natal card attribute is contrary to the fire element, and absorbing it will only be harmful rather than beneficial. "
Hearing this, Lin Qi's sinking heart suddenly started beating again, and the light ignited in his eyes again.
"That's right! My leader has fire resistance. As long as you are watching me while I am absorbing the flame card talisman, and if you see something is wrong and you use a healing card on me, I won't believe that I can't absorb it."
Angela was shocked when she heard Lynch's thoughts.
"This method may really work. The fire resistance property can help you resist the erosion of the fire element, and with the healing card in place, the risk will be much smaller."
Thinking that Lynch had always been greedy for money and liked Kahn, Angela added: "Even if you don't use it yourself, you can get a good price by selling the flame card talisman."
Lin Qi looked disapproving: "I have never seen this thing in an auction house, and I just heard you say that its power to improve is limited, and it probably won't fetch a good price."
Angela raised her eyebrows, obviously not expecting that there would be times when Lin Qi was ignorant.
"In our principality, flame card talismans are indeed rare, so the price is not high. But at the kingdom's large-scale auction, the price of a flame card talisman is comparable to an epic card. The supply is definitely in short supply."
"What?"
Mavis exclaimed, her eyes widening.
She quickly turned around and ran to her pile of ore, squatting on the ground and rummaging around, fearing that she had missed something.
"Let me see if there are any missing cards. Maybe there are some."
"Is it so expensive?"
Lin Qi couldn't believe it.
He never expected that this seemingly inconspicuous card talisman would be so valuable!
